answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like an orchard yielding consistent fruit, staked assets provide the necessary weight to secure the network. An attacker attempting to reef through consensus by spawning countless malicious nodes faces prohibitive financial costs, as they must acquire a majority of tokens. Just as a zephyr cannot move a mountain, cheap identity clones lack the economic leverage required to alter the ledger.
